title: [SOLVED] No sound after update on Thinkpad X1
body: Hello, after `pacman -Syu` (probably on 18th of October 2026, but I'm not sure), I don't have any sound on my internal speakers. A few weeks back, everything was fine. I have tried to downgrade the following packages, but without any success: - wireplumber - libwireplumber - sof-firmware I've also switched between the kernels linux and linux-lts, wtihout success. Systeminfo: - Kernel: 6.18.58-1-lts - DE: Cosmic 1.10.0-1 - Hardware: Thinkpad X1 Carbon Gen 14 - Installed packages (only relevant ones): sof-firmware (2026.09.2-1), alsa-ucm-conf (1.2.16.1-1), pipewire-alsa (1:1.6.10-1), jack2 (1.9.22-2), wireplumber (0.5.18-1). speaker-test -Dhw:0 -c2 speaker-test 1.2.16 Playback device is hw:0 Stream parameters are 48000Hz, S16_LE, 2 channels Using 16 octaves of pink noise Playback open error: -2,No such file or directory systemctl --user status pipewire ● pipewire.service - PipeWire Multimedia Service Loaded: loaded (/usr/lib/systemd/user/pipewire.service; disabled; preset: enabled) Active: active (running) since Mon 2026-10-26 08:53:33 CET; 34min ago Invocation: 81345b56da4842ec92d1293d2383c0a7 TriggeredBy: ● pipewire.socket Main PID: 1024 (pipewire) Tasks: 3 (limit: 37850) Memory: 4.9M (peak: 6.7M) CPU: 64ms CGroup: /user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/session.slice/pipewire.service └─1024 /usr/bin/pipewire Oct 26 08:53:33 qomet systemd[832]: Started PipeWire Multimedia Service.
